This is a straightforward navigation/exploration task where the agent must locate a block of red concrete powder placed in the scene. It is observable and verifiable (the agent needs to look at or be near the block), requires no deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, and can be set up with a clear scene design. Since only 1 task is required, there are no dependencies to chain, but the task itself is well-suited for benchmarking an agent's ability to explore and identify specific blocks in the environment.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate/observe' task. The player must navigate near the red concrete powder block (placed at [7, 0, 0] spawn-relative, i.e., 7 blocks east of spawn at ground level) and be facing toward it, modeling that the player has visually located and is looking at the target block. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable exploration distance (sandbox showed agent identified it from ~7 blocks away), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the block rather than just passing nearby.

scene_description: A small exploration area with three distinct structures serving as landmarks: an oak planks hut to the southeast, a stone bricks building to the northwest, and a cobblestone wall with colored concrete blocks to the southwest. The target red concrete powder block is placed 7 blocks east of spawn at ground level, flanked by orange and white concrete blocks as visual distractors. The agent must explore the area and locate the red concrete powder among the various colored blocks and structures.
task_text: Find the red concrete powder block in the area. Explore the surroundings and locate the red concrete powder.
design_notes: Red concrete powder is at ~7 ~0 ~0 (7 blocks east of spawn, ground level). It rests on the grass block below (~7 ~-1 ~0), which is safe since concrete powder is gravity-affected. It's flanked by orange concrete (~7 ~0 ~-1) and white concrete (~7 ~0 ~1) as visual distractors with contrasting colors and textures. Three landmark structures (oak hut SE, stone bricks NW, cobblestone wall SW) provide exploration waypoints. The scene is compact within 8 blocks of spawn. No water sources are present, so no risk of the concrete powder converting to concrete.
